fact: 1923年，奇塔兰詹·达斯（C.R. Das）和莫蒂拉尔·尼赫鲁共同创建自治党（Swarajya Party），作为国大党内部的一个派系，主张进入立法议会从体制内反对英国政策（而非甘地的不合作路线）。1924年自治党已成为重要政治力量。12月自治党在加尔各答及周边地区组织「自治周」（Swaraj Week）运动，募集约5万卢比用于村级组织和政治受难者基金。

sources.title: Times of India, Commemorating 100 years of Swaraj week
sources.quote: The Swarajya Party, co-founded by Das and Motilal Nehru in 1923, emerged as a faction within the Congress. Dissatisfied with the non-cooperation approach, the Swarajya Party sought to engage with legislative councils to oppose British policies from within the system. By 1924, the party had established itself as a significant force. ... The funds collected, amounting to an impressive Rs. 50,000, were allocated to support village organizations and aid political sufferers.

sources.title: Edukemy, Swarajists
sources.quote: In the years 1924-25, the Swarajists achieved several victories in the Legislative Assembly. They succeeded in throwing out the Budget, passed resolutions, and introduced bills for the repeal of certain laws. ... In Bengal, they formed the largest party and created a deadlock by opposing the government.

fact: 1924年9—10月，甘地为促进印度教徒与穆斯林的社群团结进行了21天绝食，震动全国。各宗教领袖聚集德里商讨遏制社群仇恨的对策。10月英国当局颁布《孟加拉条例》（Bengal Ordinance），以镇压无政府暴力为名压制自治党。甘地随后到加尔各答与达斯和莫蒂拉尔·尼赫鲁签署「加尔各答协议」（Calcutta Agreement），允许自治党以国大党名义开展议会活动（使用自有资金），甘地和「不变者」（No-changers）专注于建设性工作。

sources.title: MAHATMA GANDHI Volume V: INDIA AWAKENED
sources.quote: In September-October 1924 Gandhiji undertook a 21-day fast for communal unity. The fast stirred the conscience of the nation. ... British rulers in October 1924 issued the so-called Bengal Ordinance, ostensibly to suppress anarchical violence but in fact to suppress the Swaraj Party. ... Gandhiji considered it necessary to mend the fences with the Swarajists and unite the Congress. He went to Calcutta and signed a pact with C. R. Das and Motilal Nehru, under which the Swaraj Party was permitted to carry on the parliamentary programme in the name of the Congress, albeit with its own funds.

sources.title: Gandhipedia, Resolution on Calcutta Agreement and Spinning Franchise, Belgaum Congress
sources.quote: The Congress hereby endorses the following agreement between Mahatma Gandhi on the one hand and Deshbandhu C. R. Das and Pandit Motilal Nehru acting on behalf of the Swaraj Party on the other. ... The Congress congratulates the Swarajists and others arrested under the New Ordinance or Regulation III of 1818.

fact: 1924年12月26日，第39届国大党贝尔高姆（Belgaum）大会召开，甘地亲自主持。大会批准了加尔各答协议，并通过了纺纱特权（spinning franchise）决议：国大党各级组织成员须穿手工纺纱编织的卡迪布（khaddar），并每年缴纳2万码手纺纱作为订阅。自治党在孟加拉成为最大党派，在中央省获得绝对多数。

sources.title: Gandhipedia, Resolution on Calcutta Agreement and Spinning Franchise, Belgaum Congress
sources.quote: Every person not disqualified under article IV and paying a subscription of 4 annas per year shall be entitled to become a member of any organization controlled by the Provincial Congress Committees. ... Every person ... shall be entitled to become a member of any primary organization ... provided that no one shall be a member of any Congress Committee or organization who does not wear hand-spun and hand-woven khaddar at political and Congress functions or while engaged in Congress business and does not make a contribution of 20,000 yards of evenly spun yarn per year.

sources.title: Edukemy, Swarajists
sources.quote: The Swarajists' success in Bengal and the Central Provinces was notable. In Bengal, they formed the largest party and created a deadlock by opposing the government. In the Central Provinces, they secured an absolute majority and refused to accept ministerial positions.

fact: 1920年代印度的纺织业是最大的现代工业部门，孟买和加尔各答是纺织中心。自治党的「自治周」募集约5万卢比用于村级组织，显示基层动员的资金规模有限。国大党的成员订阅为每年4安那（1/4卢比），后改为2万码手纺纱——政治参与的经济门槛很低。印度的英国殖民经济以原材料出口和制成品进口为主，本土纺织资本在斯瓦德西（Swadeshi）运动中受到政治推动。

sources.title: Times of India, Commemorating 100 years of Swaraj week
sources.quote: The funds collected, amounting to an impressive Rs. 50,000, were allocated to support village organizations and aid political sufferers.

sources.title: Gandhipedia, Resolution on Calcutta Agreement and Spinning Franchise
sources.quote: Every person not disqualified under article IV and paying a subscription of 4 annas per year shall be entitled to become a member of any organization controlled by the Provincial Congress Committees.

fact: 1924年10月英国当局颁布《孟加拉条例》，以镇压无政府暴力为名压制自治党的政治活动。自治党成员被依据《1818年条例III》（Regulation III of 1818，一项允许无审判拘留的殖民法律）逮捕。甘地的21天绝食和加尔各答协议部分缓解了政治紧张，但英国的殖民法律框架未变。

sources.title: MAHATMA GANDHI Volume V: INDIA AWAKENED
sources.quote: British rulers in October 1924 issued the so-called Bengal Ordinance, ostensibly to suppress anarchical violence but in fact to suppress the Swaraj Party, which had emerged as a major political force to challenge the British rule.

sources.title: Gandhipedia, Resolution on Calcutta Agreement and Spinning Franchise
sources.quote: The Congress congratulates the Swarajists and others arrested under the New Ordinance or Regulation III of 1818 and is of opinion that such arrests are inevitable so long as the people of India have not the capacity for vindicating their status and liberty.

fact: 1920年代印度的本土纺织工业在斯瓦德西运动的推动下发展：手工纺纱（charkha）和手工织布（khaddar）被国大党提升为政治象征（「自由的制服」）。同时现代纺织工厂（孟买、加尔各答）继续运营。印度本土银行和保险公司在1920年代逐步筹备和成立，为本土资本提供金融服务。斯瓦德西运动同时是经济运动（发展本土工业、减少英国进口）和政治运动（自治）。

sources.title: GIPE, Finance Under Provincial Autonomy
sources.quote: The Swadeshi movement which was started as early as 1907, now became one of the chief planks of this political organisation. It took the form of an intense propaganda for hand-spinning and hand-weaving of cotton so much so, that the charkha came to be considered as the symbol of political freedom. ... khaddar became a fashion, and in course of time the khaddar uniform came to be considered in the words of Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru 'the livery of our freedom.'

sources.title: Edukemy, Swarajists
sources.quote: Swadeshi, which encompassed the use of indigenous industries, particularly the spinning wheel (Charkha) and coarse cloth (Khadi), held great significance in Gandhi's constructive programme. Gandhi envisioned Swadeshi as a comprehensive mentality that aimed to meet all essential needs through the labour and intellect of the villagers.

fact: 1920年代印度的金融体系由英国殖民银行（如汇丰银行、麦加利银行）和少数英资银行主导，本土银行和保险公司在斯瓦德西运动的政治推动下逐步筹备和成立。印度卢比与英镑挂钩（1卢比=1先令4便士，即1英镑=15卢比），汇率由英国殖民当局管理。自治党在1924—25年的立法议会中「成功否决了预算」，显示印度本土政治力量对殖民财政的干预能力有限但存在。

sources.title: Edukemy, Swarajists
sources.quote: In the years 1924-25, the Swarajists achieved several victories in the Legislative Assembly. They succeeded in throwing out the Budget, passed resolutions, and introduced bills for the repeal of certain laws.

sources.title: GIPE, Finance Under Provincial Autonomy
sources.quote: During the period 1921-1937 the state in India as we saw before was altered to some extent in its structure. Those functions which if properly carried out were likely to result in economic progress like agriculture, industries, education, sanitation and so on were in the hands of the Provinces. ... they realised more than ever that economic progress was bound up in many respects with political liberty.
